events.title: Lingo Café & Candies Around the World
events.location: Language Lab, Martha T. Nesbitt Building, Room 4201
events.summary: Practice your language over candy from around the world. Taste, compare, and talk with other students and Lab assistants.

extra_credit.note: Extra credit is up to each instructor. Ask yours whether this event counts in your course.

mini_project.title: Taste & tell
steps: Try at least two candies from different countries.
Describe each one in Spanish: where it's from and what it's like (dulce, ácido, picante, salado).
Say which one was your favorite and why (porque…). SPAN 1002: tell it in the past (probé, me gustó).
mini_project.deliverable: A short paragraph or a 1-minute video in Spanish.
mini_project.submit: Where and when to submit is posted in D2L.

events.title: Día de Muertos
events.location: Language Lab, Martha T. Nesbitt Building, Room 4201
events.summary: Celebrate Día de Muertos: the traditions, the altars, and the people we remember. Bring your mini-ofrenda for the competition.

extra_credit.note: Extra credit is up to each instructor. Ask yours whether this event counts in your course.

mini_project.title: Mini-ofrenda competition
steps: Build a small ofrenda (shoebox size or smaller) for a person, pet, or figure you want to remember.
Include at least 4 traditional elements and label them in Spanish: las velas, las flores de cempasúchil, el pan de muerto, el papel picado, las fotos.
Add a card in Spanish: who it honors and why (3–5 sentences).
mini_project.deliverable: Bring your mini-ofrenda to the event on Nov 4 for the competition. Can't attend? Submit a photo of it with your card.
mini_project.submit: Where and when to submit is posted in D2L.

events.title: Lingo Café: Karaoke
events.location: Language Lab, Martha T. Nesbitt Building, Room 4201
events.summary: Sing in the language you're learning, or just come to listen and chat. No experience needed.

extra_credit.note: Extra credit is up to each instructor. Ask yours whether this event counts in your course.

mini_project.title: Event Reflection
steps: Stay at least 30 minutes. Proof: a photo of you at the event, or a lab assistant's initials.
Write 3 words or phrases you heard, saw or sang, with their meaning.
Ask someone 2 questions in the language you're learning, and note the answers.
In English, write 2–3 sentences about one thing you learned about a culture or tradition.
Write 5 sentences about the event in the language you're learning.
mini_project.deliverable: The sheet (photo or scan) and your event photo
